layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Spinosaurid dorsal sail morphology
features: A large, semicircular clay sail rising from the back of a theropod
The sail is supported by long, thin clay neural spines that create visible vertical ridges
The 'skin' of the sail is a vibrant orange-to-yellow gradient clay with dark, charred-looking tips at the top
The dinosaur's body is a reddish-brown clay with cream-colored horizontal stripes
The texture is smooth with fine scale details, giving it a high-quality collectible figurine look
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic profile shot emphasizing the height and color of the dorsal sail. Professional studio lighting highlights the translucent quality of the thin clay sail edges. This serves as a 'Dorsal Sail' morphology icon. No text.
